observations.geometry: Owner reports horizontal stretch absent and appropriate side area/pillarboxing on the tested widescreen display. Photos corroborate visible margins; no universal 4:3 or all-profile claim.
observations.input: Keyboard and joystick test PASS as owner-reported. Photo shows key code 89 and neutral JOY2 31; transitions and joystick behavior are not photographically proven.
observations.audio: All three expected SID voices/tones heard. This does not qualify PSID/RSID playback, SID fidelity or stereo.
observations.video: Video/input suite reported PASS; still photo shows colors/star. Motion is not photographically proven or separately timed.
observations.boot_presentation: Rainbow screen, Linux/kernel/systemd messages, then Menu observed. Not a POC3 failure: quiet boot/performance optimization was out of scope.
observations.reboot: Normal reboot returned automatically to Menu; no broader configuration-persistence inference.
observations.root_cause: POC3 correction resolves observed geometry defect on this Pi 3B/display. Actual POC2 renderer/mode/downstream scaling responsibility remains unconfirmed. POC1 single root cause also remains unconfirmed.
observations.foundation: Suitable basic factory + bounded Pi 3B appliance foundation; not a release, beta or RC; product/security/setup/hardware/reproducibility gates remain.

environment.display: Tested widescreen display; nominal resolution/active DRM mode not reported
environment.diagnostic_reports: No diagnostic file path supplied; actual runtime mode/renderer capture remains untested
